p: When a loan has already been charged off and you trigger a write-off, the system does not credit the receivable GL account again. Instead, it posts principal, interest, fee and penalty amounts to separate charge-off income accounts. You cannot write off a loan that has not been charged off.
h3: Write-off reason to GL account mapping
p: You can map each write-off reason to an expense GL account. When a loan product has no write-off reason configurations set and a loan is written off with a reason, the default mapping is shown.
The following rules apply to write-off reason to GL account mappings:

ul.li: The write-off reason field is optional.
Multiple write-off reason to expense GL mappings can be configured, but the same reason code cannot be configured twice.
For one write-off reason code, only one GL account can be configured.
The same GL account can be configured for multiple write-off reasons.
Adding the same write-off reason twice with different expense accounts on a loan product is prohibited and shows an error on submit.
When advance accounting is mapped for a write-off reason and that reason is used, the mapped GL account is used instead of the default mapping.

p: A mapping entry uses two identifiers:

ul.li: The write-off reason code value id must be a valid, existing id of a write-off reason code value.
The expense GL account id must be a valid, existing Expense GL account id.

p: A new Advance Accounting rule maps write-off reason code with accounting mapping.
The loan product request includes the write-off reasons to expense mappings list with write-off reason code value id and expense GL account id fields.
Undoing a write-off works as follows:

ul.li: When undoing a transaction of type WRITEOFF (Close as written-off), the UI calls command=undowriteoff instead of command=undo.
Undo write-off is listed as an available option in the upper, right corner menu alongside Recovery payment.

p: During write-off, the UI lists all available write-off reason code values and lets you select one. Loan details retrieve the selected write-off reason code value.
The write-off page marks Write off on as required and offers Cancel and Submit buttons.
You write off a loan account from its actions page. The write-off applies when the loan was not charged off, and no changes are required for it to work as expected.

ol.li: Open the loan account actions page and choose "Write Off" from the actions to open the write-off screen.
Enter Write off on, optionally enter Amount, Reason for Write-Off, Note and External Id, then choose Submit.
